body.p:
When creating custom actions for the AI Positron, a specific applicationContext parameter can be added to AI actions in a JSON action/agent definition file to provide the LLM with the following editing session details:
Name and version of the Oxygen application.
Name and version of operating system.
Locale language information.
Current date (day, month, year).
Project root folder.
List of files referenced in the Main files folder.
Current file opened in the DITA Maps Manager view.
Current file opened in the main editor area. Includes caret line/column and selection information.
Skills support (header information from all skills is expanded in the application context metadata).
In addition, if the currently edited document or DITA map is changed, the LLM receives information about the change.
